svg.title: RockENZO — animated terminal profile
svg.desc: Original ASCII-filled rounded ROCK lettering over animated ASCII waves. Headline cycles through Praxis, Palimpsest and Autopoiesis. Focus: web development, scalable apps, AI and ML. Core: Python, React, Vue, Elasticsearch, Docker, Streamlit. AI and ML: LangChain, LangGraph, Deep Agents, AutoGen, PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy. LLM tools: Codex, Claude Code, DeepSeek Harness, Hugging Face and Ollama. Asynchronously suspended rounded letters with an ASCII-text fill sit over a decorative, multi-source ASCII interference background. Reveal and cursor effects do not execute commands or represent live system activity.
